claim_text: The imported target-side report can support DarwinAI board-level conclusions.
DarwinAI is the private target in this case and has a public technology description.
Public reporting indicates Apple acquired DarwinAI; terms are not disclosed in this package.
Strategic alternatives framework can be delivered for human review.
Financial fairness or offer attractiveness can be certified.
Remain independent, raise financing, seek another buyer, license technology, or partner without sale are valid alternatives to evaluate.
DarwinAI should accept, reject, or negotiate the offer.
